intents.quick_task: project-memory-refresh → plan-expert → quality-assurance-agent or tdd (non-trivial code only) → implement-task → code-review → create-pr
intents.implementation: project-memory-refresh → quality-assurance-agent or tdd (non-trivial code only) → implement-task → code-review → create-pr
intents.refactor: project-memory-refresh → codebase-design → plan-expert → implement-task → code-review → create-pr
intents.bug: project-memory-refresh → bug-diagnosis → quality-assurance-agent or tdd (non-trivial code only) → implement-task → code-review → create-pr
intents.accessibility_audit: project-memory-refresh → a11y-auditor → implement-task if fixes are requested
